items.desc: A library of Agent Skills designed to work with the Stitch MCP server. Each skill follows the Agent Skills open standard, for compatibility with coding agents such as Antigravity, Gemini CLI, Claude Code, Cursor.

A Claude Code skill bundle for bug hunting and external red-team work - 82 skills, 15 slash commands, 681 disclosed-report patterns curated across 24 core vulnerability classes, plus enterprise identity + infrastructure attack matrices.

Multi-tier framework for evaluating AI agent skills with quality gates, semantic overlap detection, synthetic evaluation dataset generation, and live agent evaluation that measures how skills affect agent behavior.

A controlled AI workflow for Blender: every copilot edit is a supervised tool call—proposed, approved, executed in sequence, cancellable after the current step and undoable by name—inside a visual studio with a built-in MCP server. · blender-ai-copilot-flow · blender · blender 3d · blender addon · blender plugin · blender extension
